methodology: Already revealed cases. Deterministic single-site mutations are admitted only when the red target becomes green and the green control remains green.

intervention_receipts.before:
def.type === "promise" ||
    def.type === "optional" ||
    def.type === "nonoptional" ||
    def.type === "nullable" ||
    def.type === "readonly" ||
    def.type === "default" ||
    def.type === "prefault" ||
    def.type === "catch"
intervention_receipts.after:
!(def.type === "promise" ||
    def.type === "optional" ||
    def.type === "nonoptional" ||
    def.type === "nullable" ||
    def.type === "readonly" ||
    def.type === "default" ||
    def.type === "prefault" ||
    def.type === "catch")

intervention_receipts.before: typeof key === "string" || typeof key === "number" || typeof key === "symbol"
